posts.title: Change your perspective of the event
posts.description: Changing your perspective is one of the hardest cognitive reappraisal techniques. Here are some examples of changing your perspective: See the event from your manager’s perspective. See the event from your children’s eyes. See the event from your parent’s perspective.
